assessments.reasoning: The Debian 0.3-24 capture supplies the bounded passage, including the Itai Nahshon copyright and both years. Its full digest matches the claim. [Debian capture](https://sources.debian.org/data/main/x/xzoom/0.3-24/xzoom.c)

The standalone text on raw.githubusercontent.com matches all 92 ordered tokens, including attribution, and its path pins the tag target. [SPDX text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/text/xzoom.txt)

The fixed detail has licenseId xzoom and its decoded licenseText matches all 92 tokens. Its template and HTML use a copyright placeholder. The detail's display name is xzoom License and its external cross-reference is marked invalid and offline. [SPDX detail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/json/details/xzoom.json)

The captured GitHub API tag object names v3.29.0 and targets commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, which appears in both exact xzoom paths in spdx/license-list-data. [Annotated tag](https://api.github.com/repos/spdx/license-list-data/git/tags/76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b)

challenge.method: Extracted the copyright-to-source-location passage independently from xzoom.c, the standalone text and decoded licenseText. Compared ordered lowercase letter-or-digit tokens, raw passages and surrounding material. Checked the tag target against both fixed URLs.
challenge.results: The three token counts were 92, 92 and 92, and both comparisons to the capture were equal in order. The two SPDX text values were identical. The raw capture differs in whitespace and continues into the Changelist and C code. The detail cross-reference points to Debian 0.3-27 copyright metadata on a different host. Both fixed SPDX URLs carry the annotated tag's target SHA.

limitations: The comparison covers the bounded notice and the fixed SPDX representations. Other versions, downstream metadata, installation, text reuse and legal effect require separate evidence.
The annotated tag is unsigned. Release authenticity here rests on the captured repository API route and tag object.
reasoning: Both fixed representations reproduce the ordered bounded tokens. The tag target independently identifies their pinned data revision. The source outside the notice and the detail metadata leave the bounded result intact.
